subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this issue, or close that path and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but a linked fork PR already carries the focused fix with closing syntax, so starting another automated repair path would risk duplicating active work.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof as needed.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repo PR
options.body: Close or set aside the fork path and ask for a new narrow OpenClaw PR with the same resolver behavior and tests.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the starting point, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels` path and refreshing proof as needed.
